name: OEDRO 6.8 Inch Dual-Raised Running Boards Fit 2019-2026 Ram 1500 Crew Cab, Heavy Duty Carbon Steel Drop Step Nerf Bars, 550 lbs Capacity, Anti-Slip Truck Side Steps
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
Upgrade your pickup with OEDRO Heavy-Duty 6.8" Dual-Raised Running Boards, designed to deliver the perfect balance of rugged strength, off-road styling, and everyday convenience. Built from high-strength carbon steel with a precision-engineered polygonal tube structure, these side steps provide exceptional durability and a bold, aggressive appearance that enhances your truck's overall profile. The innovative dual-step layout offers multiple access points, making it easier to enter the cabin, reach roof racks, or load cargo in the bed. With a bolt-on, no-drill installation design, these running boards combine functionality, safety, and style for drivers who demand more from their truck accessories.
Features
Custom Fit for 2019-2026 Ram 1500 Crew Cab: Designed specifically for 2019-2026 Dodge Ram 1500 Crew Cab models, OEDRO running boards provide a factory-style fit while upgrading your truck's accessibility, protection, and aggressive appearance.
Dual-Raised 4-Zone Step Design for Maximum Convenience: Featuring an innovative dual-level step layout with four stepping zones, these side steps offer easier cab entry while providing convenient access to roof racks, truck beds, and cargo areas.
6.8" Wide Polygonal Carbon Steel Construction: Built with a reinforced 6.8-inch wide polygonal carbon steel tube structure, these nerf bars deliver exceptional strength, off-road durability, and enhanced protection against rocks, debris, and daily impacts.
Triangular Multi-Tube Structure Supports 550 lbs: The welded triangular support design improves load distribution and overall stability, supporting up to 550 lbs per side without flexing, making them ideal for daily driving, work trucks, and off-road adventures.
Bolt-On Installation with Durable Protection: Precision-welded brackets and a direct bolt-on design allow installation without drilling or vehicle modification. The corrosion-resistant powder coating helps protect against rust, weather, and harsh road conditions.
1-Year Warranty | Professional installation is highly recommended for safety.
Fitment
Compatible with 2019-2026 DodgeRAM 1500 Crew Cab.
highlights: Constructed from heavy-duty carbon steel with a reinforced polygonal tube structure, these running boards are built to withstand extreme conditions and daily heavy use. The corrosion-resistant black powder-coated finish helps protect against rust, scratches, and road debris, ensuring long-term durability and a rugged off-road appearance that lasts.

Designed for hassle-free installation, these running boards feature a direct bolt-on system that requires no drilling or complex modifications. Precision-engineered mounting brackets ensure a secure and stable fit, allowing you to complete the installation with basic tools in a short amount of time.

The smart dual-raised step system provides multiple stepping points, making it easier and safer for passengers of all ages to enter and exit the vehicle. The wide lower step offers stable footing, while the elevated step improves access to roof racks or truck bed cargo, reducing strain during loading and unloading.
